concepts.def: Check each item in order until found.
Halve a sorted list each step until found.
Swap adjacent pairs until the list is sorted.
Split, sort halves, then merge them back.
Insert each new item into its sorted place.
A list with items in a known order.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Start at the first item. Is it the target? If yes, return its index. If no, move to the next. If the list ends, return 'not found'.

Works on any list — sorted or not.
Needs a sorted list. Look at the middle. If target is smaller, search the left half; if bigger, the right half. Repeat until found or the search space is empty.
Compare each pair of neighbours, swap if out of order. After each pass the largest item 'bubbles' to the end. Repeat until no swaps happen.
